crossRefs.note: Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will…
Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”
There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob.
If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.”
Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to…
For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…

translations.web: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
translations.bsb: Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.
translations.kjv: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
translations.asv: A seed shall serve him; It shall be told of the Lord unto the next generation.
